notes: 等价重构，正常同步路径与 0.4.10 完全一致、功能不变：pushAllowed/pullAllowed 收敛为 canPush()/canPull()（判据逐字等价）；定时复查复用已 fetch 的 drift，少一次远端请求；强杀加 1.5 秒幂等节流，避免退出钩子/定时预排/前端信标重复杀同一进程族；插件根与版本收敛到 PLUGIN_DIR/PLUGIN_VERSION 单一来源，删除 lsRemoteHeads、死导入等死代码；一致性修复——market-index 时间戳统一毫秒、前导零版本补 npmVersion、打包排除临时产物、还原流程 AppRoot 探测与实验 bundle（app.asar）识别对齐主链路、语言头改为请求时计算、callUpdate 补失败判断。 selftest/clientcheck 与 0.4.10 基线逐项一致（本环境 8 项 prepare 失败为无 origin 的既有失败，非本版引入）。
notesEn: Equivalent refactor: the normal sync path is identical to 0.4.10 and no feature changes. pushAllowed/pullAllowed are consolidated into canPush()/canPull() (criteria word-for-word equivalent); the periodic re-check reuses the already-fetched drift, saving one remote request; force-kill gets a 1.5s idempotent throttle so the close hook / periodic pre-queue / frontend beacon do not kill the same process family repeatedly; plugin root and version consolidate to a single PLUGIN_DIR/PLUGIN_VERSION source, removing dead code (lsRemoteHeads, unused imports). Consistency fixes: market-index timestamps normalized to milliseconds, leading-zero versions gain npmVersion, packaging excludes temp artifacts, the restore flow's AppRoot detection and experimental-bundle (app.asar) recognition align with the main path, the language header is computed at request time, and callUpdate checks failures. selftest/clientcheck match the 0.4.10 baseline item by item (the 8 prepare failures here are pre-existing with no origin, not introduced by this release).
